## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues when relevant.

## Validation

List the relevant checks actually run and their results. Separate unit/build results from physical-device evidence. Explain any checks that could not run.

## Compatibility and privacy

- [ ] Existing pairing, protocol and installed-app identities remain compatible, or the migration is documented.
- [ ] Permissions and payload/path/queue bounds were considered where affected.
- [ ] No private research, device data, credentials, signing keys or generated outputs are included.
- [ ] User-visible text and documentation are in English.

## Risks

Describe meaningful limitations, rollout/migration concerns and recovery steps. Mark sections not applicable when appropriate.
